name: house-rules
description: Holds six rules at the tool call, so a reminder or a habit cannot win over them: no Claude attribution in commits or pull requests, no em dash in anything written, one full sentence per line of Markdown, no file written from a shell heredoc or here-string, the unslop skill loaded before any Markdown write, and no changelog or generated file changed by hand. Carries the unslop and technical-writing skills, and correct, which turns the corrections agents keep getting in a project into checks.
